title: Coacervate formation studied by explicit solvent coarse-grain molecular dynamics with the Martini model.
authors: Tsanai, Maria; Frederix, Pim W J M; Schroer, Carsten F E; Souza, Paulo C T; Marrink, Siewert J
one_liner_zh: 该文用Martini 3.0粗粒化显式溶剂分子动力学模拟复杂凝聚体（多聚赖氨酸/多聚谷氨酸）的形成及离子/小分子分配，虽对象为多肽而非典型IDP且未聚焦具体PPI，但为IDR介导的相分离凝聚体机制建模提供了可迁移的物理模拟方法。
abstract: Complex coacervates are liquid-liquid phase separated systems, typically containing oppositely charged polyelectrolytes. They are widely studied for their functional properties as well as their potential involvement in cellular compartmentalization as biomolecular condensates. Diffusion and partitioning of solutes into a coacervate phase are important to address because their highly dynamic nature is one of their most important functional characteristics in real-world systems, but are difficult to study experimentally or even theoretically without an explicit representation of every molecule in the system. Here, we present an explicit-solvent, molecular dynamics coarse-grain model of complex coacervates, based on the Martini 3.0 force field. We demonstrate the accuracy of the model by reproducing the salt dependent coacervation of poly-lysine and poly-glutamate systems, and show the potential of the model by simulating the partitioning of ions and small nucleotides between the condensate and surrounding solvent phase. Our model paves the way for simulating coacervates and biomolecular condensates in a wide range of conditions, with near-atomic resolution.
abstract_zh: 复合凝聚物是液-液相分离系统，通常包含带相反电荷的聚电解质。它们因其功能特性以及作为生物分子凝聚物在细胞区室化中的潜在参与而被广泛研究。溶质扩散和分配到凝聚物相中对于解决这些问题至关重要，因为其高度动态性质是它们在真实世界系统中最重要功能特征之一，但在没有明确表示系统中每个分子的情况下，实验甚至理论上都难以研究。在此，我们提出了一种基于Martini 3.0力场的复合凝聚物显式溶剂分子动力学粗粒化模型。我们通过重现聚赖氨酸和聚谷氨酸系统的盐依赖性凝聚来证明该模型的准确性，并通过模拟离子和小核苷酸在凝聚物与周围溶剂相之间的分配来展示该模型的潜力。我们的模型为在广泛条件下以近原子分辨率模拟凝聚物和生物分子凝聚物铺平了道路。
